Working notes — claims triage (CLM-7001–7010)

- Small paper claims with no inconsistencies (home power surge, health specialist consult) approved and settled. Paper filing alone is not a rejection reason.
- Large payout alone is not a rejection reason. Health claims rejected for large amount, paper channel, premiums being current, or pending verification were valid on appeal. Do not reject health claims on those grounds alone.
- Auto claims rejected for amount-to-damage mismatch or suspected inflation were valid on appeal. Treat mismatch as a cue for more evidence, not as sufficient rejection.
- Home online claims are high-risk. Approvals of online home burst-pipe/water-damage claims—large and small—were later found fraudulent. Require stronger independent verification before approving online home claims.
- “Photos pending” is ambiguous. It did not justify rejecting a health claim, but supported rejecting a home online large storm-damage claim later confirmed fraudulent. Use it with category/context, not alone.
- First claim on policy is not a reliable rejection reason: one approved and settled; one auto rejection was overturned.
- Administrative notes—docs scanned/attached, claimant reachable, call notes filed—do not establish legitimacy or fraud.
- Online approvals in this sample all later proved fraudulent. Before approving any online claim, seek corroboration beyond the portal filing.
- Paper small claims remain the safest approvals when details are consistent.
- Correct rejection so far: home online large storm damage with pending photos and confirmed fraud. Overturned rejections clustered around health large, auto large/mismatch, and proxies like channel/amount/first claim.

Guideline: decide on concrete evidence and category-specific red flags; avoid single-factor rejections.

Working notes — claims triage (CLM-7001–7020)

- Paper small claims with consistent details remain safe approvals (home surge, health consult). Paper filing alone is not a rejection reason.
- Large payout alone is not rejection. Health large/phone/first-claim approved and settled. Premiums current, first claim, reachability, call notes, and scanned/attached docs are neutral administrative facts—neither legitimacy nor fraud.
- Auto amount-to-damage mismatch or suspected inflation rejections were valid on appeal. Treat mismatch as a cue for more evidence, not sufficient alone.
- Home online claims are high-risk. Every online home claim in the sample (small/large; power surge, break-in, storm) was rejected and confirmed fraudulent, even with neutral notes (call notes, docs scanned, reachable, first claim). Do not approve online home claims without independent corroboration beyond the portal filing.
- “Photos pending” is ambiguous: not enough alone. It supported rejecting home online large storm fraud, but home paper small and home phone large claims approved with it. Use only with category/context.
- Phone home claims approved and settled across break-in, power surge, and storm; small and large. Health phone large approved. These are safer when no specific red flag is present.
- First claim on policy is not a reliable rejection reason.
- Correct rejection so far: home online with no corroboration, confirmed fraud. Overturned rejections clustered around health large, auto large/mismatch, and proxies like channel, amount, or first claim.

Guideline: decide on concrete evidence and category-specific red flags; avoid single-factor rejections. For online home, require corroboration.

Working notes — claims triage (CLM-7001–7030)

- Neutral/admin facts alone do not decide: first claim, premiums current, reachability, call notes, scanned/attached docs, photos pending, and channel (phone/online) are neither proof of fraud nor proof of legitimacy. Do not reject on these alone.
- Health claims are generally safer: phone/online, small/large, first claim, and photos pending approved/settled when no concrete health red flag appears (CLM-7021, 7026–7028). Online health large first claim was valid.
- Home claims need more caution. Online home still requires independent corroboration beyond the portal filing, but online alone is not enough to reject: a small online break-in rejection was overturned as valid (CLM-7024).
- Phone home is not automatically safe: large phone burst-pipe and break-in claims approved, then audit found fraud (CLM-7022/23). Phone small break-in with consistent details settled (CLM-7025).
- Auto: amount-to-damage mismatch is a cue for more evidence, not sufficient alone. Auto phone large with scanned docs approved, then audit found fraud (CLM-7029). Auto online small with call notes approved/settled (CLM-7030).
- “Photos pending” remains ambiguous; use only with category/context.
- Decision rule: approve only with concrete support and no category-specific red flag; reject only with specific fraud evidence or a real corroboration gap. Online home: require corroboration. Phone home and large auto: neutral admin notes may be insufficient if other red flags exist. Avoid single-factor decisions.

Working notes — claims triage (CLM-7001–7040)

- Neutral/admin facts alone do not decide: first claim, premiums current, reachability, call notes, scanned/attached docs, photos pending, channel, amount. They are neither proof of fraud nor legitimacy. Do not approve or reject on these alone.
- Health: online and paper claims can be safe (CLM-7032 online small; CLM-7040 paper large settled). But health phone large is now high-risk: CLM-7032/7034/7036/7038/7039 were approved on neutral facts, and audits found fraud. Reachability, premiums current, first claim, photos pending did not help. Require concrete corroboration beyond the health category before approving health phone large.
- Home: phone small can settle with call notes (CLM-7035). Phone large with only reachable info was rejected/fraud (CLM-7037); corroboration gap. Online home still needs independent corroboration.
- Auto: amount-to-damage mismatch is a cue. Large phone with scanned docs and mismatch was rejected/fraud (CLM-7031). Not sufficient alone, but needs corroboration.
- “Photos pending” remains ambiguous; it is not support. Use only with category/channel/amount context.
- Decision rule: approve only with concrete support and no category/channel/amount red flag. Red-flag patterns: health phone large; home phone large; auto large with amount-damage mismatch. Reject with specific fraud evidence or a real corroboration gap. Paper/online may be safer but are not automatic. Avoid single-factor decisions.

Working notes — claims triage (CLM-7001–7050)

Neutral/admin facts (first claim, premiums current, reachability, call notes, scanned/attached docs, photos pending, channel, amount) are not decisive alone. Do not approve or reject on these alone.

Health:
- Online/paper can be safe: 7040, 7042, 7043, 7045 valid. Paper large is not a red flag; do not reject health paper large solely for photos pending/lack of corroboration (7045 overturned).
- Health phone large remains red flag: 7048 confirmed fraud; earlier health phone large audits found fraud. Require concrete corroboration beyond neutral facts.

Home:
- Phone small can settle: 7035, 7046, 7047. First claim/reachability neutral.
- Home phone large with only reachable info: 7037 fraud; corroboration gap. Online home still needs independent corroboration.

Auto:
- Amount-to-damage mismatch is red flag, especially large phone: 7031, 7041 confirmed fraud. Call notes/scanned docs do not cure.
- Auto online/phone small can settle: 7044, 7050.
- Auto paper large can be valid; do not reject solely for large/paper/reachability (7049 overturned).

Decision rule:
Approve only with concrete support and no red flag. Red flags: health phone large; home phone large; auto large with amount-damage mismatch. Reject only with fraud-specific evidence or a true corroboration gap, not neutral facts alone. Paper/online may be safer but not automatic. Avoid single-factor decisions. Photos pending is ambiguous; not support.

Working notes — claims triage (CLM-7001–7060)

Neutral/admin facts (first claim, premiums current, reachability, call notes, scanned/attached docs, photos pending, channel, amount) are not decisive alone. Do not approve or reject on these alone.

Health:
- Online/paper can be safe: 7040, 7042, 7043, 7045 valid. Paper large is not a red flag; do not reject health paper large solely for photos pending/lack of corroboration (7045 overturned).
- Phone small can settle: 7052.
- Health phone large remains red flag: 7048, 7054, 7057 confirmed fraud. Require concrete corroboration beyond neutral facts.

Home:
- Phone small can settle: 7035, 7046, 7047. First claim/reachability neutral.
- Home phone large with only neutral/reachable info: 7037, 7051, 7056 confirmed fraud; corroboration gap.
- Home online small can be valid: 7055 rejected but appealed valid. Do not reject solely for lack of corroboration/neutral facts.

Auto:
- Amount-to-damage mismatch is red flag, especially large phone: 7031, 7041, 7053, 7059 confirmed fraud. Call notes/scanned docs do not cure.
- Auto online/phone small can settle: 7044, 7050.
- Auto paper large can be valid: 7049, 7058 overturned; 7060 approved. Do not reject solely for large/paper/reachability.

Decision rule:
Approve only with concrete support and no red flag. Red flags: health phone large; home phone large; auto large with amount-damage mismatch. Reject only with fraud-specific evidence or a true corroboration gap, not neutral facts alone. Paper/online may be safer but not automatic. Avoid single-factor decisions. Photos pending is ambiguous; not support.

Working notes — claims triage (CLM-7001–7070)

Neutral/admin facts (first claim, premiums current, reachability, call notes, scanned docs, photos pending, channel, amount) are not decisive. Do not approve/reject on these alone.

Health:
- Online/paper small/large can be valid: 7040, 7042, 7043, 7045, 7064, 7066, 7068. Paper large not red flag.
- Phone small can settle: 7052.
- Phone large: 7048, 7054, 7057 fraud, but 7069 rejected then appealed valid. Not automatic reject; fraud risk remains, require concrete support.

Home:
- Phone small can settle: 7035, 7046, 7047.
- Home phone large with only neutral info: 7037, 7051, 7056 fraud; corroboration gap.
- Online small/large can be valid: 7055 appeal valid; 7062, 7063, 7065 settled. Do not reject solely for lack corroboration/neutral facts.

Auto:
- Amount-to-damage mismatch is red flag, especially large phone: 7031, 7041, 7053, 7059 fraud. Call notes/docs do not cure.
- Small auto can be fraud: 7061 online small, 7067 paper small, 7070 paper small approved then audit fraud. Do not auto-approve small/online/paper/first claim.
- Auto online/phone small can settle: 7044, 7050. Paper large can be valid: 7049, 7058, 7060.

Decision rule:
Approve only with concrete support and no red flag. Red flags: auto large amount-damage mismatch; home phone large corroboration gap. Treat health phone large as caution, not automatic. Reject only with fraud-specific evidence or true corroboration gap, not neutral facts alone. Paper/online not safer. Avoid single-factor decisions. Photos pending ambiguous; not support.
